reading.zh: MVP 三件套的现状：view 是已实现的面板；model 目前只有一个手写 DTO（生成的 ConfigData/ModelData 归属配置表管线，不在本层）；presenter 是空目录占位。
reading.en: The MVP trio as it stands: view holds the implemented panels; model has a single hand-written DTO (generated ConfigData/ModelData belongs to the config pipeline, not here); presenter is an empty placeholder.
